breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two conflicting time integration methods: 'Explicit forward Euler' and a more detailed 'Deterministic IMEX (1st order)' scheme. The agent correctly identified the conflict, discarded the simpler 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction, and accurately described the IMEX scheme, which matches the resolution in the ground truth prompt.
